fields.Name: Skip ICF - Revenue Breakdown by Product Category
fields.Description: Share of confirmed revenue by product category (Memberships, Events, Publications & Goods, Certifications & Training, General). Ported from "Revenue Breakdown by Source".

InputDefinition.userMessage: What percentage of our confirmed revenue comes from each product category (memberships, events, publications, certifications, and so on)? Show this as a pie or donut chart. When I click a slice, show me a table of the order lines in that category. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a pie or donut chart of revenue share by product category
Uses Order Lines joined to Products and Product Categories, for confirmed sales orders
Memberships (about 50%) and Events (about 47%) dominate; Publications & Goods, Certifications & Training and General are small slices
Percentages add up to about 100% and slices are labelled with category and amount or percent
Clicking a slice shows the order lines in that category (order number, date, product, amount)
Rows can open the underlying order record
